summary: Iteration 73 (FRONTEND ONLY) — Verified the three new features shipped this round: cart qty stepper, Pay Online (mock Razorpay), Wallet+Online combo, order display of online orders, and Reorder. 6 of 8 requested flows PASSED end-to-end; ONE flow (Wallet+Online combo place-order) SILENTLY FAILED to create an order after tapping Pay ₹175 — the button click completed with no error alert visible on screen, no dialog was captured, wallet balance did not change (₹5000 → ₹5000) and no new order was created (order count remained 53). The full-online path in the SAME session worked perfectly (SC-495863-1 / SC-495863-2, paid_via=online, online_paid=100+250, cod_due=0, payment_status=paid). The other issue is UX-only: Alert.alert on React-Native-Web is rendering as an in-page modal that the automation tooling can't dismiss AND that dismisses itself in some flows before the user can read it — 'Only N left in stock' banner from the stock cap never became visible during 8 rapid + taps (Playwright dialog handler saw 0 dialogs, DOM sweep found 0 error text) even though the backend correctly returned 400. Cart stepper +/- works, checkout button live-updates (₹450 after +1 on Test Widget), stock cap held at qty=4 (product stock=4), trash-at-qty-1 removed the V2 Gadget row. Full-online mock flow worked: Pay Online option + 'Pay ₹350' button, ~1.2s mock roundtrip, order verified & placed, 2-order split created, wallet untouched. Wallet+Online split box shows FROM WALLET / PAY ONLINE labels (correct — not CASH ON DELIVERY when online is selected), auto-maxes to ₹350/₹0, chip 50% → ₹175/₹175, Max → ₹350/₹0, sticky label 'WALLET ₹175 + ONLINE', place button 'Pay ₹175' — the visuals were 100% correct but the actual place-order request didn't produce a new order (see high-priority bug below). /orders correctly renders 'Paid online' and 'Wallet + Online' labels; existing SC-495863 online orders show 'Paid online · Paid' and no 'due on delivery' on those specific cards. Reorder passed: button on placed orders, first tap → cart has 1 x Vendor One Widget ₹100; second tap → qty stacked to 2 (₹200) — no crash; alert text couldn't be captured but the cart state is correct. Regression: multi-seller notice, group header '1 checkout · 2 sellers 2/2', Test Shop + Vendor Two Store cards still render correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping 'Pay ₹175' with paymentMethod='wallet_online' + walletPart=175 + cashPart=175 did NOT create a new order. Wallet balance stayed at ₹5000, no new order appeared in /api/orders/me (still 53), no error alert was seen on-screen and no window.alert dialog was captured. The full-online (paymentMethod='online') flow in the same session worked perfectly, so the /orders/payment/start → mock gateway → /orders/payment/verify → /orders/checkout pipeline is fine for the pure-online path. Suspect: either onPlaceOrder is throwing between collectOnlinePayment() and the /orders/checkout POST (the mock roundtrip succeeded because the sticky button spun for a second), OR /orders/checkout is rejecting payment_method='wallet_online' with wallet_amount>0 and payment_id set, and Alert.alert(...formatApiError(e)...) is firing but React-Native-Web is dismissing/hiding it before the user sees it. Please add a visible error toast/banner (not Alert.alert) around the combo path and log the exception. Reference: /app/frontend/app/checkout.tsx:378-461 (onPlaceOrder), especially the collectOnlinePayment() → /orders/checkout with wallet_amount handoff.

When the buyer keeps pressing qty-plus past available stock (Test Widget stock=4, tried 8 rapid presses) the backend correctly returns 400 with 'Only 4 left in stock' but the user sees no feedback: qty simply stops at 4. The React-Native-Web Alert.alert() in the adjust() catch either never fires or is instantly dismissed by the next tap. Consider replacing Alert.alert with an in-place toast/inline error under the stepper so a real thumb-mashing user learns why the counter won't budge. Reference: /app/frontend/app/cart.tsx:74-88.

ui_bugs.component: checkout.tsx / orders.tsx — post-place alert not visible
ui_bugs.issue: The success alert emitted by announcePlaced() (e.g. 'Order placed! 🎉 ...₹100 debited from your wallet, ₹250 paid online...') was NOT visible on screen or captured by page.on('dialog') for the full-online flow either, even though the order was correctly created. On RN-Web, Alert.alert renders as a modal but seems to be immediately eaten by focus/blur here. Same story for the Reorder 'Added to bag' alert — the cart is correctly updated but the buyer gets no confirmation feedback. Consider replacing Alert.alert with the existing OutOfZoneModal-style bottom-sheet or a toast library.

integration_issues.issue: UI shows the correct split, but the /orders/checkout leg does not create an order in this scenario. Full-online works in the same session with the same payment gateway pipeline, so the divergence is specific to wallet_online with wallet_amount>0.

issues: Same overhang the previous iteration flagged for wallet_cod is present here — the sticky 'Pay ₹X' footer overlaps the wallet-split quick-chip row on 390×844. Not blocking; chips still respond to force-click. Consider bumping ScrollView paddingBottom past 240 when comboMode is true and the address form is filled.

react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert renders behavior across the app (stepper stock-cap, reorder confirmation, checkout success, checkout failure) is inconsistent on web preview — the modal is either invisible, un-clickable, or immediately dismissed. This is a shipping-blocker for real buyers who need to see 'Only 4 left in stock', 'Added to bag' or 'Order placed!' feedback. Recommendation: introduce a shared Toast/BottomSheet component and route the four success/error paths through it. Reference: /app/frontend/app/cart.tsx:86, /app/frontend/app/checkout.tsx:329, /app/frontend/app/orders.tsx (reorder handler).

action_items: HIGH — Investigate why Wallet+Online combo (paymentMethod=wallet_online, wallet_amount=175, payment_id set, cash total 175) does NOT create an order. Full-online works in same session, so isolate the wallet_online branch of /orders/checkout (backend) OR the payload built by onPlaceOrder (frontend). Print server-side logs during the click and confirm the /orders/checkout POST actually reaches the backend with the expected shape. May need to also verify /orders/payment/start returned amount_paise = 17500 (cashPart) rather than the full ₹350.

MEDIUM — Replace Alert.alert calls in cart.tsx (stock-cap error), checkout.tsx (announcePlaced success + Checkout failed / OOZ error), and orders.tsx (reorder success / 'Can't reorder this') with a persistent Toast/BottomSheet so RN-Web actually surfaces the message. Currently the automation captured NO dialogs and NO on-screen error text after any of these events even though the underlying state changes were correct.
LOW — Bump ScrollView paddingBottom past 240 in checkout.tsx when comboMode is on and address is filled so the wallet-split chip row is not visually overlapped by the sticky CTA at 390px.
TESTABLE — Once Alert.alert is replaced with a testable component (add a testID like 'toast-message'), the next iteration will be able to assert stock-cap and reorder feedback text end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: checkout.tsx:427-433 — collectOnlinePayment() returns null on user-cancel, which is caught with setPlacing(false)+return, but any thrown error inside collectOnlinePayment (e.g. verify HMAC fail) surfaces via outer catch and Alert.alert. Given the observed Alert.alert invisibility, users will see the sticky button spin briefly and then return to idle with no clue as to why nothing happened. Add an in-line error banner state.

checkout.tsx:196 total = sum of line_total — good, but /orders/payment/start prices the cart server-side (per the spec), so if server total ≠ ui total (e.g. race between add-to-cart and payment/start), the mock roundtrip proceeds against the server number and the UI 'Pay ₹X' may lie. Consider echoing server-side amount_paise back into the sticky label after /orders/payment/start.

cart.tsx:74-88 — adjust() sets busyLine and awaits load(); the ActivityIndicator between the +/- buttons is a nice touch but the disabled=!!busyLine means a rapid button masher hits nothing until the round-trip completes — this already prevents oversell, so it's actually protecting the backend. Good defensive design.
orders.tsx reorder handler (not shown in files_of_reference render) — cart state is correctly updated (verified via /api/cart) but no visible confirmation. Route through the same new Toast component.

success_rate.frontend: 6/8 requested flows fully green; 1 flow (wallet+online combo place-order) failed silently; 1 flow (admin online order view) not verified — will be trivial once combo place-order is fixed

seed_data_creation: None. Wallet was already ₹5000 when this iteration started (main agent must have refilled between iters). Used existing seed products Test Widget (stock 4), Vendor One Widget, Vendor Two Gadget. This run created 2 new orders SC-495863-1 (Test Shop, online ₹100) and SC-495863-2 (Vendor Two Store, online ₹250) via the full-online mock flow; wallet unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) testbuyer@test.com / Test@1234 wallet is still ₹5000 (combo test did NOT debit). 2) Two new fully-online orders SC-495863-1 (₹100 Test Shop) and SC-495863-2 (₹250 Vendor Two Store) exist — good candidates to reproduce Admin → Orders → Payment box test which I couldn't verify this iteration (blocked on chasing the combo bug). 3) Test Widget stock dropped 5→4 between iterations 72 and 73 (probably from prior test carts). 4) To reproduce the combo bug: seed delivery localStorage as usual, log in as testbuyer, empty cart, add Vendor One Widget + Vendor Two Gadget (total ₹350), open /checkout, fill address, tap pay-online, toggle online-use-wallet ON, click split-chip-0.5 (Wallet ₹175 / Online ₹175), then tap place-order. Order will not appear in /api/orders/me and wallet will not change. Watch backend logs during the tap. 5) React-Native-Web Alert.alert is essentially blind in the automation harness — either fix it end-to-end OR add data-testid'd Toast so the next iteration can assert user-visible feedback.
rca_of_issue: For the Wallet+Online combo silent failure: cannot fully RCA from the frontend alone. Hypothesis A — backend /orders/checkout rejects the wallet_online payload (perhaps a mismatch between amount_paise the payment attempt was created for vs. the current cart total when wallet_amount is included), throws, Alert.alert('Checkout failed', ...) fires but RN-Web hides it. Hypothesis B — /orders/payment/verify silently returned an error that made collectOnlinePayment throw. Reproduction is deterministic (2/2 sessions attempted). Mitigation: add try/catch logging on the frontend, then re-run the test.
